intro.title: You will use these in
frames: I need to revise for the exam.
My tutor helped me with the coursework.
You need a visa for that country.
Try to memorise ten new words a day.
intro.note: revise = look at it AGAIN before an exam. Czech *opakovat* covers it, but English revision is only for study — you repeat a sentence, you revise a subject.

sentences.en: I have to revise for the exam because my teacher moved it to Monday.
sentences.cz: Musím se učit na zkoušku, protože ji učitel přesunul na pondělí.
accepts: I have to revise for the exam because my teacher moved it to Monday

sentences.en: She got a scholarship which pays for her books and travel.
sentences.cz: Dostala stipendium, které jí platí knihy a cestování.
accepts: She got a scholarship which pays for her books and travel

sentences.en: I have to finish the assignment before the library closes.
sentences.cz: Musím ten úkol dokončit, než knihovna zavře.
accepts: I have to finish the assignment before the library closes

sentences.en: I can't concentrate when the children are playing in the garden.
sentences.cz: Nemůžu se soustředit, když si děti hrají na zahradě.
accepts: I can't concentrate when the children are playing in the garden
I cannot concentrate when the children are playing in the garden

sentences.en: He is still a beginner, but he learns faster than the rest of the class.
sentences.cz: Je pořád začátečník, ale učí se rychleji než zbytek třídy.
accepts: He is still a beginner, but he learns faster than the rest of the class
He's still a beginner, but he learns faster than the rest of the class

sentences.en: Write a short summary of the text that we read last week.
sentences.cz: Napiš krátké shrnutí textu, který jsme četli minulý týden.
accepts: Write a short summary of the text that we read last week

sentences.en: My tutor helped me with the coursework after the lesson finished.
sentences.cz: Můj tutor mi po hodině pomohl s prací do kurzu.
accepts: My tutor helped me with the coursework after the lesson finished

sentences.en: Our departure was delayed because the road to the airport was closed.
sentences.cz: Náš odjezd se zpozdil, protože byla silnice na letiště uzavřená.
accepts: Our departure was delayed because the road to the airport was closed

sentences.en: You need a visa if you want to work in that country for a year.
sentences.cz: Potřebuješ vízum, pokud chceš v té zemi rok pracovat.
accepts: You need a visa if you want to work in that country for a year

sentences.en: I felt homesick after a week.
sentences.cz: Po týdnu se mi stýskalo po domově.
accepts: I felt homesick after a week

sentences.en: We visited the most famous landmark.
sentences.cz: Navštívili jsme tu nejznámější památku.
accepts: We visited the most famous landmark

sentences.en: It is easier to memorise new words when you write them down.
sentences.cz: Nová slovíčka se pamatují líp, když si je zapíšeš.
accepts: It is easier to memorise new words when you write them down
It's easier to memorise new words when you write them down
It is easier to memorize new words when you write them down

sentences.en: The exam in June was easier than we expected.
sentences.cz: Zkouška v červnu byla lehčí, než jsme čekali.
accepts: The exam in June was easier than we expected

sentences.en: Half of the mark comes from coursework, not from the exam.
sentences.cz: Polovina známky je z průběžných prací, ne ze zkoušky.
accepts: Half of the mark comes from coursework, not from the exam

sentences.en: I missed the seminar on Friday because my train was late.
sentences.cz: V pátek jsem zmeškal seminář, protože mi jel vlak pozdě.
accepts: I missed the seminar on Friday because my train was late

sentences.en: My revision goes better when I sit in the library.
sentences.cz: Opakování mi jde líp, když sedím v knihovně.
accepts: My revision goes better when I sit in the library

sentences.en: This semester is harder than the last one because we have more lessons.
sentences.cz: Tenhle semestr je těžší než ten minulý, protože máme víc hodin.
accepts: This semester is harder than the last one because we have more lessons

sentences.en: She left her textbook on the train, but the station office found it.
sentences.cz: Nechala si učebnici ve vlaku, ale kancelář na nádraží ji našla.
accepts: She left her textbook on the train, but the station office found it

sentences.en: My phone is the biggest distraction when I study.
sentences.cz: Telefon je pro mě při učení největší rozptýlení.
accepts: My phone is the biggest distraction when I study

sentences.en: You get a certificate when you finish the course.
sentences.cz: Když kurz dokončíš, dostaneš certifikát.
accepts: You get a certificate when you finish the course

sentences.en: He put his diploma on the wall because his mother asked him to.
sentences.cz: Diplom si pověsil na zeď, protože ho o to máma požádala.
accepts: He put his diploma on the wall because his mother asked him to

sentences.en: My sister will graduate in June if she passes the last exam.
sentences.cz: Moje sestra dokončí studium v červnu, pokud udělá poslední zkoušku.
accepts: My sister will graduate in June if she passes the last exam

sentences.en: As an undergraduate he worked in a shop, but the money was never enough.
sentences.cz: Jako student bakalářského studia pracoval v obchodě, ale peněz nikdy nebylo dost.
accepts: As an undergraduate he worked in a shop, but the money was never enough

sentences.en: The tuition is higher than my parents can pay each year.
sentences.cz: Školné je vyšší, než kolik můžou rodiče každý rok zaplatit.
accepts: The tuition is higher than my parents can pay each year

sentences.en: We need someone with real expertise, but nobody in the office has it.
sentences.cz: Potřebujeme někoho se skutečnou odborností, ale nikdo v kanceláři ji nemá.
accepts: We need someone with real expertise, but nobody in the office has it

sentences.en: She has a talent for languages that her brother never had.
sentences.cz: Má talent na jazyky, jaký její bratr nikdy neměl.
accepts: She has a talent for languages that her brother never had

sentences.en: The theory is easy, but the practice takes years.
sentences.cz: Teorie je snadná, ale praxe trvá roky.
accepts: The theory is easy, but the practice takes years

sentences.en: The police wanted proof that the car was mine.
sentences.cz: Policie chtěla důkaz, že to auto bylo moje.
accepts: The police wanted proof that the car was mine

sentences.en: Send me the itinerary before we leave on Thursday.
sentences.cz: Pošli mi itinerář, než ve čtvrtek vyrazíme.
accepts: Send me the itinerary before we leave on Thursday

sentences.en: Nobody stopped us at customs because our bags were small.
sentences.cz: Na celnici nás nikdo nezastavil, protože jsme měli malá zavazadla.
accepts: Nobody stopped us at customs because our bags were small

sentences.en: Our arrival was late, so the shops were closed.
sentences.cz: Náš příjezd byl pozdě, takže obchody už byly zavřené.
accepts: Our arrival was late, so the shops were closed

sentences.en: The fare to the airport is higher if you travel after ten.
sentences.cz: Jízdné na letiště je vyšší, když jedeš po desáté.
accepts: The fare to the airport is higher if you travel after ten

sentences.en: The school excursion to Kutná Hora was cancelled.
sentences.cz: Školní výlet do Kutné Hory zrušili.
accepts: The school excursion to Kutná Hora was cancelled

sentences.en: The guidebook says the church was built four hundred years ago.
sentences.cz: V průvodci se píše, že ten kostel byl postavený před čtyřmi sty lety.
accepts: The guidebook says the church was built four hundred years ago

sentences.en: We had a short stopover in Warsaw while we waited for the next plane.
sentences.cz: Ve Varšavě jsme měli krátké mezipřistání, zatímco jsme čekali na další letadlo.
accepts: We had a short stopover in Warsaw while we waited for the next plane
